title: Lazy-load the Claude Agent SDK adapter so api/codex installer editions run
description: Gate for ADR 0011 api/codex editions (eshyra-7zhm). The Codex adapter (eshyra-jl8n) already imports its SDK lazily, so @eshyra/core loads without the Codex binary. The Claude adapters do NOT: agentSdkClient.ts and agentSdkMcpClient.ts statically import '@anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk' at module scope, and index.ts re-exports them eagerly. So the api and codex editions (which prune the ~223MB Claude binary) build at the correct small size (api=166MB vs 423MB) but CRASH at startup / fail the release validator's no-config execution smoke with ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND. Work: (1) make agentSdkClient.ts + agentSdkMcpClient.ts dynamic-import('@anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk') inside complete() (mirror codexSdkMcpClient.ts), throwing a clear edition error if absent; (2) move @anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk to optionalDependencies in packages/core/package.json; (3) keep the existing vi.mock-based tests green (vi.mock intercepts dynamic import too); (4) re-enable the release validator's no-config execution smoke for ALL editions by removing the editionRunsNoConfigSmoke gate in validate-release-artifact.mjs. Verifies the editions feature end-to-end: every edition both builds lean AND runs.
close_reason: Merged in PR #254. Claude Agent SDK adapters now import the SDK lazily via agentSdkLoader.ts (types-only at module scope); claude-agent-sdk moved to optionalDependencies; validator's deferral gate removed. Proven: api (166MB) + codex (450MB) editions pass the full no-config execution smoke with the Claude SDK pruned.
